description: This file defines various enums, structs, and utility functions related to execution approval policies and security in the OpenClaw project. It manages allowlists, security levels, decision states, and configuration handling for execution approvals, including storage and resolution logic.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the exec-approvals.json configuration file in the application's state directory.

methods.name: socketPath
methods.description: Provides the filesystem path for the exec-approvals socket.

methods.name: normalizeIncoming
methods.description: Normalizes an ExecApprovalsFile, processing legacy patterns and ensuring fields are set correctly.

methods.name: readSnapshot
methods.description: Reads the current snapshot of the exec approvers configuration, returning default or existing data.

methods.name: redactForSnapshot
methods.description: Removes sensitive information (like tokens) from the ExecApprovalsFile for snapshot purposes.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads the ExecApprovalsFile from disk, returning default data if loading fails.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves the given ExecApprovalsFile to disk.

methods.name: ensureFile
methods.description: Ensures the configuration file exists, creates it if necessary, and returns the current ExecApprovalsFile.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the current Execution Approval configuration for a given agent ID, including defaults.

methods.name: resolveReadOnly
methods.description: Reads the current configuration without modifying or writing files.

methods.name: resolveFromFile
methods.description: Resolves configuration details from a given ExecApprovalsFile and agent ID.

methods.name: resolveDefaults
methods.description: Returns the default execution approval settings, resolving from current configuration.

methods.name: saveDefaults
methods.description: Persists default approval settings.

methods.name: updateDefaults
methods.description: Updates default approval settings with a mutation.

methods.name: saveAgent
methods.description: Saves an approval agent's configuration.

methods.name: addAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist pattern to the specified agent if valid.

methods.name: recordAllowlistUse
methods.description: Records usage of an allowlist pattern for a specific agent and command.

methods.name: updateAllowlist
methods.description: Updates the allowlist for a specific agent, returning rejected entries.

methods.name: updateAgentSettings
methods.description: Updates agent-specific settings.

methods.name: ensureSecureStateDirectory
methods.description: Creates the storage directory with secure permissions.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a secure random token string.

methods.name: hashRaw
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash of a raw string.

methods.name: hashFile
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash of a given ExecApprovalsFile.

methods.name: expandPath
methods.description: Expands user directory symbols (~) in paths.

methods.name: agentKey
methods.description: Returns the normalized key for an agent, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: normalizedPattern
methods.description: Validates and normalizes allowlist patterns.

methods.name: migrateLegacyPattern
methods.description: Migrates legacy allowlist patterns to the current format.

methods.name: normalizeAllowlistEntries
methods.description: Normalizes and optionally drops invalid allowlist entries.

methods.name: mergeAgents
methods.description: Merges two approval agents, combining allowlists and settings.

methods.name: validateAllowlistPattern
methods.description: Validates if an allowlist pattern matches required path components.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Checks if a pattern contains a path component.

methods.name: parseDecision
methods.description: Parses a string into an ExecApprovalDecision enum.

methods.name: requiresAsk
methods.description: Determines if user confirmation is required based on current settings.

methods.name: allowlistPattern
methods.description: Derives a pattern string from command and resolution info.

methods.name: containsPathComponent
methods.description: Checks if a pattern includes a path component such as '/', '~', or '\'.
